exposure: Mothers who did not attend psychoprophylaxis courses (Sample 2)
cohort: 200 mothers who gave birth in two public and three private maternity hospitals in Larissa, Greece.
finding: Psychoprophylaxis courses have positive effects on labor outcomes and breastfeeding practices.
mod_finding: Women who attended psychoprophylaxis courses were more likely to give birth naturally (60% vs 52%, p=0.01).
